title: Scientific Closure Ledger

calibration_history.summary: 23/25 item accuracy; K0D, K1, and K2 saturated at 5/5. Binary item accuracy could not resolve treatment differences.
Receiver-visible answer leakage / lexical cueing detected before calls. Redesign required.
Receiver-clean five-item pilot again scored 23/25 with K0D, K1, and K2 at 5/5; 2/5 clusters showed across-arm variance.
Shifted calibration from narrative incident difficulty to matched relational contrast pairs.
Execution was genuine, but frozen fixture bytes / key commitment changed after scientific approval; preserved as exploratory protocol-deviation episode and excluded from official gate adjudication.
Clean 50-unit relational-contrast recovery episode with exact deployment-source attestation, blind raw freeze, append-only key reveal, and preregistered pairwise scoring.

pair_04_diagnostic.bounded_interpretation: K3 uniquely preserved the preregistered PASS-to-HELD predecessor-continuity distinction in this pilot episode. The signal is hypothesis-generating only because it occurred on one pair inside an episode that failed preregistered spread and dynamic-range criteria.

canonical_closure_statement: At Gemini 3.8 Flash / medium / Vercel-preview under these receiver-clean relational contrast tasks, the preregistered binary pair-success assay did not identify an incremental Aperture effect over matched scaffolding or conventional engineering. A single Pair-04 diagnostic distinguished the full K3 governance treatment, but the episode failed preregistered spread and dynamic-range requirements, so that signal remains hypothesis-generating rather than inferential.

research_closure.rationale: Further calibration redesign aimed primarily at forcing K1/K2 separation would risk result-seeking after repeated non-identifying pilots and a clean preregistered V4.1R hold.

sequence_6_handoff.product_rule: The product is not the dissertation rendered as UI. The product is the surviving relation set rendered beautifully.
admitted_basis: Relations that survived Sequence 4 vocabulary stripping, label permutation, foreign/field projection, and structural ablation within their stated same-host scope.
Non-retroactivity and predecessor-continuity constraints as engineering invariants.
Claim ceilings and role separation as defensive product/governance affordances.
prohibited_product_claims: Do not claim Aperture or TD613 governance demonstrated causal superiority over matched scaffolding or conventional engineering in Sequence 5.5.
Do not present the Pair-04 K3 signal as statistical or causal proof.
Do not convert same-host relation survival into independent discovery or exogenous empirical validation.
